sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/10) and bearish AAII sentiment (49%) present contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no conviction signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (417.4), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising dollar pressures multinationals, and earnings in 82 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (10/10) and contrarian buy signal combined with price near support (9.4025) offer asymmetric risk/reward for contrarian traders willing to absorb macro headwinds.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro crisis (VIX 417.4, flat yield curve, rising dollar), price below all 200-day moving averages, RSI extreme overbought (80.5) with bearish stochastic cross, zero fundamental conviction, and earnings event risk in 82 days create a toxic setup that overwhelms short-term technicals.
